Class SelectionController

java.lang.Object
controllers.Controller<SelectionView>
controllers.teamchoice.SelectionController
public class SelectionController extends Controller<SelectionView>
Controller for the Bugémon selection screen. Handles both new team creation and editing of existing teams. Coordinates BugemonGridView and TeamPanelView via SelectionView.

      public int getPlayerTeamSize()

    • onBugemonClicked

      public void onBugemonClicked(javafx.scene.control.Button btn, BugemonDTO bugemon, boolean wasSelected, boolean teamFull)
      Handles a click on a Bugémon button in the grid. Adds or removes the Bugémon from the player's team, notifies the view, and pushes the updated team list to the view.
      Parameters:
      btn - the button that was clicked
      bugemon - the Bugémon associated with that button
      wasSelected - true if the button was already selected before the click
      teamFull - true if the team has already reached the maximum size

    • saveSelection

      public void saveSelection(String teamName)
      Confirms the current selection. Updates the existing team if editing, or adds a new named team to the shared list and persists it to disk.
      Parameters:
      teamName - the name for the new team (ignored in edit mode, can be null)
